# One owner for the duration

`customer_support.pb.de_escalation.one_owner_for_the_duration` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Name one owner and keep them on it until the temperature is down, even at a cost to queue efficiency.

Continuity is the visible proof that someone is in charge. The routing cost of pinning an agent is real and it is smaller than the cost of a customer who has now explained their problem to four people and concludes that nobody owns it.
